summary: Ocean Power Technologies filed an 8-K to disclose the adoption of an Amended and Restated Section 382 Tax Benefits Preservation Plan, extending the original plan by three years to June 29, 2029. The plan is designed to protect the Company's net operating losses and other tax attributes from being limited under Section 382 of the Internal Revenue Code due to an ownership change. The Board unanimously approved the amendment. No financial terms, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event is involved; this is a routine corporate governance filing to preserve tax assets.
